AI & Tech examines LLM triage, context scaling, partial routing and agent memory, plus reported talks to lift the blockade on AI agent Muse; Developer highlights a Rust VoIP stack and SQLite tools. Science covers a Harvard UV chip, a possible pre-stellar black hole candidate and deep-sea extinction-risk signals. World focuses on New Zealand's final election results, Zelensky's BBC interview and US Thanksgiving storms; China covers wage-arrears cases, e-bike firm summons and new rail lines; Finance tracks US futures, France's contraction and easing French and Spanish inflation; Opinion discusses AI self-hosting, verifiable languages and hard-drive prices. Some deals, studies and findings remain unconfirmed.

subsections.briefing_title: 深海灭绝信号、神经元功能与儿童屏幕暴露研究
subsections.briefing_summary: 科学家分析墨西哥湾五种深海鱼和虾十余年的遗传数据，发现每种受检物种都出现灭绝风险信号。另一项研究分析小鼠43个脑区记录，发现多数神经元能对多种输入作出反应，而非高度专一。研究还识别出婴儿期和正式入学初期两个潜在关键窗口，屏幕暴露较多与多年后学业表现较差、工作记忆较弱相关；X射线成像则将一块3.45亿年前化石重新归类为水生或两栖生物。
subsections.briefing_title_en: Deep-Sea Extinction Signals, Neuron Function, and Children’s Screen Exposure
subsections.briefing_summary_en: Scientists analyzing more than a decade of genetic data from five deep-sea fish and shrimp species in the Gulf of Mexico found extinction-risk signals in every species examined. Another study analyzing recordings from 43 mouse brain regions found that most neurons respond to a wide variety of inputs rather than being highly specialized. Researchers also identified infancy and the start of formal schooling as potentially critical windows, when greater screen exposure was linked to poorer academic performance and weaker working memory years later; X-ray imaging reclassified a 345-million-year-old fossil as an aquatic or amphibious creature.

articles.summary: 一篇博客文章用“Slack emoji 数量除以员工人数平方根”的公式衡量公司文化；Hacker News 条目获309分、131条评论。
articles.title_en: Company Culture = Slack Emoji ÷ √Headcount
articles.summary_en: A blog post proposes measuring company culture with a formula dividing Slack emoji by the square root of headcount; the Hacker News submission drew 309 points and 131 comments.
articles.original_title: Company Culture = Slack Emoji ÷ √Headcount
articles.reason: 以公式化方式讨论公司文化衡量，属于商业与社会评论，且 HN 讨论活跃。
articles.reason_en: It discusses measuring company culture through a formula, fitting business and society commentary, with active HN discussion.

articles.summary_en: A blog post argues that hard drive pricing has gotten bad, with the URL referring to Black Friday hard drive prices; the Hacker News submission drew 315 points and 214 comments.

articles.reason: 文章直接评论硬盘价格恶化，属于消费硬件市场与商业评论；HN 高票且评论多。
articles.reason_en: The post directly comments on worsening hard drive pricing, fitting consumer-hardware market and business commentary; it drew high points and many comments.
